test_HTTP_413_triggers_compression_retry: test that HTTP 413 errors trigger context compression and retry instead of aborting
test_HTTP_400_context_length_triggers_co: test that HTTP 400 context-length errors trigger compression instead of generic 4xx abort
test_preflight_compresses_oversized_hist: test that preflight compression reduces oversized conversation history before the first API call
test_large_tool_results_trigger_compress: test that large tool results pushing context past threshold trigger preflight compression
test_anthropic_prompt_too_long_safety_ne: test that Anthropic prompt-too-long errors trigger compression as a safety net
test_413_error_message_detection: test that 413 errors are detected via error message string when status_code attribute is absent
test_context_overflow_clears_conversatio: test that context-overflow compression passes None conversation_history to _persist_session
test_no_preflight_when_compression_disab: test that preflight compression is skipped when compression_enabled is False
test_context_length_retry_rebuilds_reque: test that retry after compression sends the compressed transcript instead of the stale oversized payload
test_413_cannot_compress_further: test that uncompressible 413 errors return a partial result with error details
